spanish: Habla a hijos de Israel, y dirás a ellos: Cuando entraren a la tierra que yo dando a ustedes, y cesará la tierra shabat a Jehová.

findings.issue: Common noun שַׁבָּת (singular absolute, not a proper name) is left untranslated as shabat.
כִּי is only a conjunction; Cuando selects the temporal sense and closes that openness.
Qal imperfect 2mp is rendered with archaic future subjunctive entraren. That ending can still be ustedes address, but it is not current Latin American (entren/entrarán).

notes: Habla/dirás (2ms), a ellos (3mp), dando (active participle), a ustedes (2mp), and Jehová match the tokens.
